description: Test suite for the game logic functions in a TicTacToe game, including tests for winner calculation, board fullness, initial state, available moves, and AI move computation.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Determines the winner ('X' or 'O') based on current board configuration.

methods.name: isBoardFull
methods.description: Checks if the game board is completely filled with no empty spaces.

methods.name: getInitialGameState
methods.description: Provides the initial state of a new game, with default or specified parameters.

methods.name: availableMoves
methods.description: Returns the list of available empty indices on the board.

methods.name: computeAiMove
methods.description: Computes the AI's move based on difficulty level and current board state.

methods.name: findBestMove
methods.description: Determines the best move for the AI to make.
